title: Tower constructions used by the Milnor sequence
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with countable products [def-weil-category-product]. For an inverse tower $M$, let $T$ act on its product by $T((m_n))=(t_n(m_{n+1}))$. Define $C(M)=\operatorname{coker}(1-T)$ and, for a tower map $f$, define $C(f)$ by the induced map on cokernels. For a tower $K$ of cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define its degree-$q$ cohomology tower by applying $H^q$ to its objects and maps. For a tower $M$ in $A$, define its single tower by applying the degree-zero single-complex functor. These are the four unchanged constructions formerly in det-pe-milnor-sequence.
